title: Grammar: c'est: identify or introduce something
subtitle: Unit 10: Housing and the lease

steps.title: C'est + a noun phrase or a general description
rows: to introduce a place with an adjective

steps.title: c'est: identify or introduce something
steps.body: Use c'est + a noun with its article: C'est un appartement; c'est une chambre. You can also use c'est for a general reaction: C'est grand !

steps.explain: Use c'est + un + noun to identify something.
Use c'est + une + noun to identify the room.

steps.prompt: You look around and say, “It's big!”
steps.explain: C'est grand ! is a general comment about the place.

steps.prompt: Which sentence says “It is a furnished apartment”?
steps.explain: Use c'est + un + noun, then the adjective.
